lines.text: The people served the LORD all through the days of Joshua and the elders, and they buried Joshua at Timnath-heres.
Joshua son of Nun died at the age of 120, and another generation rose up who did not know the LORD.
The Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD, forsook Him, and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.
The LORD raised up judges who saved Israel from plunderers, but when a judge died, the people became even more corrupt.
The LORD left the five rulers of the Philistines to test whether Israel would keep the commandments given through Aaron.
